name: Türkiye Bursları (Türkiye Scholarships)
amount: Tuition, dorm, monthly stipend, insurance, flights, Turkish course
note: One application per cycle covers undergraduate, master's and PhD. Not open to students already enrolled in Türkiye at the level they apply for (a bachelor's student there can still apply for a master's). Turkish citizens are not eligible.

name: Sabancı University International Undergraduate Scholarships
amount: Automatic tuition waivers of 25–75% (100% rarely); tuition US$36,500/yr in 2026-27
dlText: Expected: applications ~15 Dec 2026 – late Aug 2027, early deadline ~mid-Mar 2027 (based on 2026)
fields: Engineering, natural sciences, management, arts & social sciences
note: No separate scholarship application; higher waivers go mostly to early applicants. Scholarships continue for the prep year and four undergraduate years under university rules.

name: Koç University International Undergraduate Merit Scholarships
dlText: No separate deadline: every international applicant is considered automatically (check Koç's admission dates)
note: Tuition-only awards (no housing or living costs). For full funding including stipend, apply through Türkiye Bursları as well.

name: Bilkent University Comprehensive Scholarship (International)
amount: Full tuition + 18,000 TL/month for 8 months + free double dorm room (2026-27 rates)
tags: Request financial aid on the application
note: Awarded on high-school grades and exam scores. Students who don't use the dorm get an extra 13,000 TL/month (2026-27).

name: METU International Student Tuition Waivers
amount: Tuition discounts or exemptions by academic success (no other scholarships)
dlText: Expected Jul 2027 (2026 window: 1 Jun – 12 Jul); a September round may follow
note: Discounts are reviewed every year and announced by email. METU's Northern Cyprus campus has its own waiver scheme.
